claims.text: T. saginata (beef tapeworm) is treated with praziquantel;
claims.quote: Infection with the beef tapeworm, Taenia saginata, may cause mild gastrointestinal upset or passage of a motile segment in the stool. It is treated with praziquantel or niclosamide.

claims.text: niclosamide is an alternative outside the United States.
